Be a modern-day knight in shining armor to all those who are running late, close to tears, almost unable to make it to their destinations. 🚍🛡

There's just one catch. You? A bus driver. Your armor? A trusty bus!

Only you can navigate a narrow alley while sipping hot coffee and never breaking eye contact with the road. Only you can drive through heavy traffic while still smiling and being nice to every passenger who steps into your bus. 🚌💪

Become an everyday hero for the people! No stunt double required. 😎💪🏼

Pre-order the Standard or Deluxe editions to receive the Horizon Hydrogen 40ft Gen2 bus and a skin pack featuring three modern skins for your buses.

Deluxe Edition pre-orders will also include the Horizon Speed 40ft bus, a retro-style skin pack, and the Bus Pass, guaranteeing day-one access to the first three content expansions through 2026.

description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012485 

Step into the world of Hela and discover how nature and music shape the adventure.

In this new Deep Dive, the team shares how the landscapes of Northern Sweden inspired the world of Hela, and how music and sound design bring it to life. From peaceful forests and misty mires to lively settlements, every location has its own atmosphere, melodies, and mood.

Featuring music by Frida Johansson and Henrik Oja (composers known for their work on the Unravel series), this is a closer look at how Hela invites players to slow down, explore, and reconnect with nature.

Hela is coming to PlayStation®5 in 2026. Add it to your wishlist today!

#ps5 #ps5games #HelaTheGame
title: Hela - In Tune with Nature | PS5 Games

author: PlayStation
description:
GRAMMY-winning artist, composer, producer and multi-instrumentalist Laufey invites you to join her limited‑time showcase: "Laufey: The Final Hour" - a three‑act surreal fairytale set inside an enchanted castle. Players journey through Laufey’s imagination, moving from a swirling hall of mirrors and crashing pirate ship room to a towering clockwork tunnel and an intimate jazz club finale. Along the way, there are immersive performances of favorites “Lover Girl” and “Too Little, Too Late” as well as her new hit song “Madwoman” from A Matter of Time: The Final Hour. Afterward, players can stay to socialize, uncover hidden easter eggs, and take part in Laufey‑themed trivia.

Experience the limited run of "Laufey: The Final Hour" starting Friday, April 17th at 1pm ET on Fortnite. Island Code: 2267-1088-8185.

Created by Sony Immersive Music Studios in partnership with AWAL and Sony Music.

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games #fortnite #laufey
title: Laufey: The Final Hour in Fortnite | PlayStation
